accounts.currencyHint: The starting balance and the account total use this currency. The account can still hold others.

transfers.title: Transfer money
transfers.sameAccountError: Source and destination accounts must differ.
transfers.heading: Transfers

transfers.lockedBoth: Both sides of this transfer were imported, so only the description can change.

conversions.heading: Currency conversions
conversions.title: Convert currency
conversions.description: Exchange one currency for another inside the same account. Balances move; nothing counts as income or an expense.
conversions.feeHint: Recorded as an expense on this account.
conversions.accountFixedHint: A conversion stays on the account it was recorded on.
conversions.feeEditHint: The fee as it should be afterwards. Clear it to delete the fee expense.

conversions.importedHint: Imported from the broker. Correct it at the broker and import again.

tags.title: Tags
tags.name: Name
tags.explainer: A tag says what a payment was for across categories: a holiday, a renovation, something to be reimbursed. A transaction can carry several, and a tag has no income or expense side.
tags.filterHint: Only transactions carrying every chosen tag are listed.
tags.overlapHint: A transaction with several tags counts under each of them.
tags.bulkReplaceHint: The chosen tags replace whatever the selected transactions carry now.

categorizationRules.title: Categorization rules
categorizationRules.subtitle: Let a description decide the category and the tags, in the import preview and on demand.
categorizationRules.explainer: A rule reads the description of a transaction and fills in a category, tags, or both. Rules are yours alone and nobody else sees them. They are tried from the top and the first one that matches decides the row, so keep the specific ones above the general ones.
categorizationRules.name: Name
categorizationRules.patternHint: Upper and lower case do not matter. Per cent and underscore are ordinary characters, not wildcards.
categorizationRules.amountHint: In the transaction's own currency. Leave a box empty for no limit.
categorizationRules.actionHint: A rule has to set a category, a tag, or both. A run adds the tags and never removes the ones a row already carries.
categorizationRules.categoryTypeHint: An expense category only matches expenses, an income category only income.
categorizationRules.samplePlaceholder: Paste a description from a statement
categorizationRules.testerIdle: Type a sample description to see what this rule would do.
categorizationRules.testerAmountOnly: The description matches, but the amount is outside the range.
categorizationRules.orderHint: Rules are tried from the top. The first one that matches decides the row and the rest are skipped.
categorizationRules.runDescription: Only transactions with no category at all are offered to the rules. Split transactions are never touched, because their categories live on their lines.
categorizationRules.recategorize: Also replace categories that are already set
categorizationRules.recategorizeHint: Off, a transaction that already carries a category is left alone. On, a matching transaction's category is replaced by the rule's.
categorizationRules.runNothing: No transaction matches any rule right now.
categorizationRules.runNeedsRules: Add a rule first; there is nothing to run.
categorizationRules.amountRangeInvalid: The highest amount cannot be below the lowest one.

suggested.title: Suggested rules
suggested.description: You filed each of these by hand at least three times, always with the same category. Review one to adjust it before saving, or dismiss it.

question.startsWith: Always categorize descriptions starting with "{{pattern}}" as {{category}}?

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.needAccount: Create an account first to add transactions.
transactions.splitTotalMismatch: Lines total {{linesTotal}}, but the transaction is {{total}}.
transactions.selectPage: Select all transactions on this page
transactions.splitNotSelectable: Split transactions keep their categories on the lines, so they cannot be recategorized in bulk
transactions.mixedTypesHint: The selection mixes income and expenses. Select rows of one type to set a category.
transactions.savedFiltersEmpty: No saved filters yet. Filter the list, then name it here.
transactions.saveFilterNeedsFilter: Filter the list first; sorting and the page number are not saved.
transactions.savedFilterStale: Names something that no longer exists
transactions.refundedHint: Refunds that name this purchase add up to {{amount}}.
transactions.templatesEmpty: No templates yet. Open the add form and save its shape as a template.

attachments.title: Receipts and files
attachments.hint: JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC or PDF, up to {{size}} MB each and {{max}} per transaction.
attachments.drop: Drop files here or choose them
attachments.loadError: The files of this transaction could not be loaded.
attachments.fileTypeNotAllowed: {{name}} is not a JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC or PDF file.
attachments.tooMany: Only {{free}} more files fit on this transaction; {{name}} was left out.

receipts.readingHint: Reading the receipt, this takes a few seconds.
receipts.rememberedHint: You filed an item with this name under this category before.
receipts.adjustmentsHint: Shared across the lines by their size.
receipts.unread: Lines that could not be read
receipts.unreadHint: Check them on the receipt: an item among them is missing from the lines above.
receipts.itemsDiffer: The items add up to {{items}}, the receipt says {{printed}}.
receipts.paymentDiffers: Receipt {{receipt}}, this payment {{payment}}; the lines are scaled to the payment.
receipts.pagesCut: Only the first {{read}} of {{count}} pages were read.
receipts.returnReceipt: Return receipts cannot be split yet.
receipts.attachFailed: Saved, but the receipt was not attached

trash.title: Trash
trash.description: What you deleted in the last {{days}} days and can still bring back. A row leaves this list once you restore it or once it is older than {{days}} days; nothing else is removed from it.
trash.empty: You have not deleted anything in the last 30 days.

backup.title: Backups
backup.description: A backup is one file with everything in this installation: users, settings and the books of every user. Backups are kept on the server; download a copy now and then, because a backup stored next to the database is lost together with it. The file holds password hashes, so treat it as a secret.
backup.never: No backup has been taken yet.
backup.otherVersionHint: Taken by another version of the application. It can be downloaded but not restored here.
backup.empty: No backups yet. Take the first one with Back up now.
backup.uploadHint: Upload a backup you downloaded earlier, from this or another installation. It is only added to the list; nothing is restored until you choose Restore.
backup.chooseFile: Choose a backup file (.zip, or .json.gz from an older version)
backup.fileTooLarge: The file is larger than 2 GB.
backup.confirmTitle: Replace all data with this backup?
backup.confirmDescription: Everything in this installation, for every user, is deleted and replaced with the backup. This cannot be undone. Everyone is signed out, and you sign in again with a password from the backup. The backups on the server are kept.
backup.confirmPasswordHint: Your own password, to confirm it is you.
backup.restored: Backup from {{date}} restored. Sign in again.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.hint: Theme, colors and language apply to this browser only. Theme and language can also be switched from the account menu at the foot of the sidebar.

typography.title: Typography
typography.hint: Typeface and text size for this browser only.

auth.signInSubtitle: Sign in to your Jx Finance account.
auth.setupSubtitle: One-time setup for this Jx Finance install.
auth.twoFactorCodeHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code.
auth.forgotSubtitle: Type the address you sign in with. If it belongs to an account here, a link that sets a new password is sent to it.
auth.forgotSent: If that address belongs to an account here, a link is on its way. It is valid for one hour and works once.
auth.resetSubtitle: The link works once. After the change every signed-in browser of this account has to sign in again.
auth.resetLinkBroken: This link is incomplete. Ask for a new one from the sign-in screen.
auth.resetDone: Your password was changed. Sign in with it.
auth.verifyFailed: This link is no longer valid. Sign in and ask for a new one on your profile.
auth.passkeyFailed: This browser could not use a passkey. Try again or sign in with your password.

deactivateConfirm.title: Deactivate this user?
deactivateConfirm.description: They are signed out everywhere and cannot sign in. Their data is kept, and you can reactivate them later.

resetPassword.title: Set a temporary password
resetPassword.consequences: {{name}} is signed out on every device and a temporary lockout is lifted. The application does not tell them the new password: pass it on yourself and ask them to change it on Profile.
resetPassword.resetTwoFactor: Also reset two-factor authentication and passkeys
resetPassword.resetTwoFactorHint: Only needed when they also lost the authenticator and the recovery codes, or the device that holds their passkey. They set them up again after signing in.
resetPassword.currentPasswordHint: Confirms that you are the one making this change.
resetPassword.done: Password reset. {{name}} has been signed out everywhere.

dataExport.title: Export your data
dataExport.description: Download everything you own as one zip file: your accounts, personal, shared and archived, with all that is recorded on them, the transfers that touch them, and your categories, tags, rules, budgets, goals, assets, debts, recurring entries and notifications. data.json holds every record, and accounts.csv, transactions.csv and transfers.csv open in a spreadsheet.
dataExport.excluded: Passwords, two-factor secrets, passkeys, API tokens, households and other members' accounts are never included. The file cannot be imported yet.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.twoFactorDisabledSubtitle: Add an authenticator app for an extra layer of security when signing in.
profile.twoFactorEnabledSubtitle: Two-factor authentication is currently enabled for your account.
profile.scanQrSubtitle: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, or enter the key manually.
profile.recoveryCodesSubtitle: Each code can be used once if you lose access to your authenticator app. Store them somewhere safe — they won't be shown again.

sessions.title: Signed-in browsers
sessions.description: Every browser that is signed in to your account. Sign out the ones you no longer use or do not recognise.
sessions.confirmDescription: It will have to sign in again with your password.
sessions.confirmOthersDescription: Every other browser will have to sign in again. This browser stays signed in.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.description: Sign in with your phone, your computer, a password manager or a security key instead of your password and authenticator code. A PIN or your fingerprint unlocks the passkey.
passkeys.name: Name
passkeys.removeDescription: It can no longer sign in to your account.
passkeys.signOutHint: If the device with that passkey is lost, also sign out everywhere else.
passkeys.unavailable: Passkeys need this installation to be opened over HTTPS by its name, not over plain HTTP or by an IP address. Ask your administrator.
passkeys.unsupported: This browser cannot create passkeys. Use a current Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
passkeys.alreadyRegistered: This authenticator already holds a passkey for your account.
passkeys.failed: The browser could not create the passkey. Try again.

apiTokens.title: Personal API tokens
apiTokens.description: Let a script or a spreadsheet on your own computer read what you see here. A token can only read: it changes nothing and never reaches settings, backups, attachments or administration.
apiTokens.name: Name
apiTokens.copyFailed: The browser did not allow copying. Select the token and copy it yourself.
apiTokens.shownOnce: You will not see this token again. Keep it where your script can read it, such as an environment variable.
apiTokens.revokeDescription: Scripts and spreadsheets that use it stop working at once.

profile.emailUnconfirmedBody: {{email}} is not confirmed yet, so this installation sends no mail to it. Nothing else is blocked.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Every notification appears under the bell. Tick the ones that should also reach you by email or in your Discord channel.
notifications.needsEmail: Email is unavailable: this installation cannot send mail yet. Ask an administrator to set up the mail server.
notifications.needsVerification: Email is unavailable until you confirm your address.
notifications.discordNotAllowed: Discord is unavailable: an administrator has not allowed it on this installation.
notifications.discordNotConnected: Connect a Discord channel below to use the Discord column.
notifications.discordPaused: Discord is paused. Tick “Send notifications to this channel” below to resume.
notifications.digestOnlyOutside: Only sent by email or Discord
notifications.digestNote: The monthly digest arrives in the first days of each month and sums up the month that ended: income and expenses, the categories that moved most and what is still open before you close it. Tick Email or Discord to receive it.

discord.title: Discord channel
discord.description: Post your notifications to a Discord channel of your own. Only you receive them; nobody else in the household sees your channel.
discord.webhookUrlHint: In Discord: channel settings, Integrations, Webhooks, New webhook, Copy webhook URL.
discord.removeDescription: Messages still waiting to be sent are dropped. In-app notifications are not affected.
discord.gone: Discord says this webhook no longer exists. Create a new one in Discord and paste its URL.
discord.unreadable: The saved webhook can no longer be read, usually after a restore from another installation. Paste the webhook URL again.
discord.webhookPlaceholder: Saved. Paste a new URL to replace it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Apply to everyone who uses this installation.

general.title: General
general.instanceNameHint: Shown beside the logo and in the browser tab. Leave empty to use the product name.
general.supportLink: Show the Support on Ko-fi link
general.supportLinkHint: Off hides the link in everyone's sidebar. It is a plain link, so nothing is loaded from Ko-fi either way.

features.title: Features
features.description: A feature that is off disappears from the navigation and its pages stop loading. Its data is kept and returns when you turn it back on.

budgets.name: Budgets
budgets.hint: Weekly, monthly, quarterly or yearly limits per category.

recurringBills.name: Recurring entries
recurringBills.hint: Due dates and reminders for recurring expenses, income and transfers. Off also stops the reminders.

netWorth.name: Net worth
netWorth.hint: Assets, debts and history. Off also stops the daily snapshot.

reports.name: Reports
reports.hint: Income and expense summaries over any period.

import.name: Statement import
import.hint: Bank statement upload, CSV or XML.

households.name: Households
households.hint: Sharing accounts and categories with other users.

multiCurrency.name: Multiple currencies
multiCurrency.hint: Currency pickers, conversions and cross-currency transfers.

investments.name: Investments
investments.hint: Securities, trades, dividends and Interactive Brokers import.

categorizationRules.name: Categorization rules
categorizationRules.hint: Rules that fill a category and tags from a description, in the import preview and on demand.

unusualAmounts.name: Unusual amounts
unusualAmounts.hint: Flags expenses far above what their payee or category usually costs, and subscriptions charged more than expected. Off also stops the check and its notifications.

monthClose.name: Month-end close
monthClose.hint: A page that walks through each finished month and freezes its figures when you close it. Later changes show as drift. Off also stops the monthly reminder.

receiptReading.name: Receipt reading
receiptReading.hint: Fills a transaction's split from a receipt photo or PDF, read on this server with Tesseract; nothing is sent anywhere.

apiTokens.name: Personal API tokens
apiTokens.hint: Members can create read-only tokens for their own scripts and spreadsheets. Off suspends every token until it is on again.

currencies.title: Currencies
currencies.reportingHint: Totals, budgets and reports are shown in this currency.
currencies.reportingChangeWarning: Saving revalues every transaction at the rate on its own date. Budgets, goals, assets, debts, bills and net worth history keep their numbers, so review them afterwards.
currencies.enabledHint_one: {{count}} currency is offered when entering data. The reporting currency is always included.
currencies.enabledHint_other: {{count}} currencies are offered when entering data. The reporting currency is always included.
currencies.enabledOff: Multiple currencies is off, so only the reporting currency is offered.

rates.title: Exchange rates
rates.autoSyncHint: European Central Bank reference rates, at startup and every six hours. Turn off if this server must not make outbound requests.
rates.upToDate: Rates are already up to date

regional.title: Regional
regional.languageHint: Used until someone picks a language themselves.
regional.timeZoneHint: Decides what counts as today and this month.

defaults.title: Defaults
defaults.accountHint: Preselected when adding a transaction, for users who can see it.

smtp.title: Email
smtp.description: The mail server this installation sends through. Without it there are no password reset links, no address confirmations and no reminder emails.
smtp.enabledHint: Turn off to stop every outgoing message without losing the settings.
smtp.hostHint: The SMTP host name, for example smtp.example.com.
smtp.userNameHint: Leave empty for a relay that needs no sign-in. Clearing it also forgets the password.
smtp.passwordHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again. Leave empty to keep the stored one.
smtp.fromAddressHint: The address recipients see, for example finance@example.com.
smtp.fromNameHint: Shown beside the sender address. Leave empty to use the address alone.
smtp.testHint: Save first. The message goes to your own address and nothing is stored.

discord.title: Discord
discord.description: Members can post their own notifications to a Discord channel through a webhook on their profile. This switch allows or stops that traffic for everyone.
discord.enabledHint: Messages go from this server to discord.com. While this is off nothing is sent, and members' webhooks stay saved.

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.subtitle: One limit per category and period, each counted inside its own window.
budgets.rollover: Carry what is left into the next window
budgets.rolloverHint: An unspent remainder raises the next window's limit; an overspend lowers it. The carry looks back at most twelve windows.
budgets.needCategory: Create an expense category first to set a budget.

suggestions.title: Steady spending without a budget
suggestions.description: These categories cost about the same in each of the last six months and have no monthly budget.

commandPalette.title: Command palette
commandPalette.description: Type to search pages, accounts, categories, tags and actions. Move with the arrow keys, choose with Enter, close with Escape.

goals.title: Goals
goals.name: Name
goals.needAccount: Add an account first, or track this goal by hand.
goals.manualHint: Raise the current amount yourself as you save.
goals.progressUnavailableHint: The funding account is archived or no longer shared with you.
goals.monthlyEstimate: Estimated {{amount}} a month to reach it

netWorth.title: Net worth
netWorth.notEnoughHistory: Check back after a couple of snapshots to see a trend.
netWorth.name: Name
netWorth.compositionLabel: Accounts, assets and debts over time

repayment.title: Repayment terms
repayment.hint: Optional. With the loan amount, rate, first payment and a term or a monthly payment the debt gets a repayment schedule.
repayment.termOrPayment: Give a term or a monthly payment, not both.
repayment.linearNeedsTerm: A linear schedule is set by its term; leave the monthly payment empty.

schedule.incomplete: Add the loan amount, interest rate, first payment and a term or a monthly payment to this debt to see its schedule.

schedule.savings_other: Paid off {{date}}, {{count}} payments sooner, saving {{amount}} in interest.

depreciation.title: Depreciation
depreciation.hint: Straight line: the value falls by the same amount each month, on the start date's day, down to the residual value. A new valuation restarts the decline from that value.
depreciation.lifeRange: The useful life is 1 to 600 months.
depreciation.startDateInvalid: Pick a start date that is not in the future.
depreciation.residualTooHigh: The residual value must be below the start value.

asset.chartLabel: Value of the asset by date, with its valuations marked

valuations.title: Valuations
valuations.hint: What the asset was worth on a date. A deleted valuation cannot be restored.
valuations.dateFuture: The date cannot be in the future.

tracking.hint: The balance becomes the amount below on its date, less the principal of the payments you link to this debt after it.

payments.title: Linked payments
payments.anchor: {{amount}} on {{date}}, less the principal paid since. A regular payment pays a month of interest at the debt's rate first; an extra payment is all principal.
payments.incomplete: Some payments have no exchange rate for their date and are left out of the balance.
payments.unavailable_one: {{count}} linked payment was deleted or is no longer shared with you, so it is left out.
payments.unavailable_other: {{count}} linked payments were deleted or are no longer shared with you, so they are left out.

kinds.auto: Regular, or extra if the month has one

payments.principalHint: Optional. Replaces the split worked out from the rate.

investments.title: Investments
investments.description: Securities, trades and income across your investment accounts.

summary.incomplete: Some holdings have no price or exchange rate and are left out of these totals. Set a price in the holdings table to include them.

price.label: Last price ({{currency}})
price.hint: The price with the newest date is the last price. An earlier date only adds a point to the history. A broker import records the price of its report date.

priceHistory.title: Price history
priceHistory.hint: One price per date, newest first. Saving a price for a date that is already listed replaces it.

valueChart.title: Value over time
valueChart.label: Portfolio market value and invested cost over time
valueChart.empty: Nothing was held in this range.
valueChart.partial: On some dates a holding had no price or exchange rate yet and is left out of both lines. Add earlier prices in the price history to fill them in.

years.title: Income by year
years.empty: No income or realised gains yet.

tax.title: Investment tax summary
tax.description: One calendar year of what was recorded: disposals, income and charges.
tax.accountsHint: Nothing chosen means every account you can see.
tax.exportHint: Every row of this year as a spreadsheet file.
tax.disclaimer: This is a summary of what you recorded, not tax advice. It applies no tax, rate or allowance and names no tax form. Check the figures against your broker's own statements before you use them.
tax.relatesToReports: The same dividends, interest, withholding tax and fees are already counted in reports and on the dashboard as income and expense. This page lists them one by one for a single year and adds the realised gain of each disposal, which reports never carry. Nothing here is counted twice, and prices in the price history never change these figures, because a price only affects unrealised value.
tax.incomplete: At least one holding was sold without a recorded purchase, so a cost basis on this page is incomplete. Add the missing entries and open this page again.
tax.disposalsHint: Each sale with the lots it consumed, oldest lot first.
tax.noDisposals: Nothing was sold in this year.
tax.noIncome: No dividends or interest in this year.
tax.noCharges: No withholding tax or fees in this year.

entry.description: Record a trade, income or a charge on an investment account. The account's cash balance follows.
entry.feeHint: Broker commission, in the security's currency.

validation.quantity: Enter a quantity greater than 0 with up to 8 decimals, e.g. 2.5.
validation.ratio: Enter the ratio as new shares per old share, e.g. 2.
validation.isin: Enter a valid ISIN, e.g. IE00BK5BQT80.

securities.title: Securities
securities.description: Everything you can trade or receive income from. Prices are kept by hand or updated by a broker import.
securities.addDescription: A symbol can exist once per currency.
securities.name: Name
securities.currencyHint: Prices, trades and dividends for this security use this currency.

import.noAccounts: Add an account of type Investment first.
import.fundingHint: Deposits and withdrawals become transfers to or from this account. Without it they are skipped.
import.chooseFile: Click to choose an XML file
import.fileHint: Activity Flex Query exported as XML, up to 20 MB. The import is all or nothing.
import.fileEmpty: This file is empty. Run the Flex Query again and choose the new file.
import.fileTooLarge: This file is larger than 20 MB. Export a shorter period.
import.uploading: Importing the report. Large reports can take a moment.

result.cashEntries_other: {{count}} dividend, tax, interest or fee entries imported.

result.duplicates_other: {{count}} entries were already imported and left alone.

help.title: How to create the Flex Query
help.create: In Interactive Brokers Client Portal open Performance & Reports, then Flex Queries, and create an Activity Flex Query.
help.sections: Add the sections Trades (with Executions selected), Cash Transactions and Open Positions.
help.format: Set the format to XML and the date format to yyyyMMdd.
help.period: Choose a period, for example Last 365 days, then save the query and run it to download the file.
help.token: For automatic sync, open Flex Web Service on the same page, enable it and copy the token.
help.queryId: The Query ID is the number shown next to the saved query.

warning.title: Check your holdings
warning.skippedActions: These corporate actions are in the report but were not booked. Enter their effect by hand:
warning.mismatches: For these securities the quantity calculated from your entries differs from what the broker reports:
warning.mismatchTable: Holdings that differ from the broker
warning.mismatchAdvice: A corporate action may be missing, or the history starts before the first imported period. A split can be entered by hand with Add entry, type Split.

connection.description: Jx Finance fetches the Flex Query once a day and imports whatever is new. The token is stored encrypted and is never shown again.
connection.queryIdError: The Query ID is the number shown next to your Flex Query.
connection.tokenHint: The number Interactive Brokers shows when you enable the Flex Web Service.
connection.tokenError: Enter the token as 6 to 64 digits.
connection.syncDailyHint: Turn off to keep the connection for manual syncs only.
connection.syncing: Fetching the report from Interactive Brokers. This can take up to a minute.

empty.title: No investments yet
empty.description: Record buys, sells, dividends and fees to see holdings, gains and income by year. Entries move the cash balance of the account they belong to.

recurringBills.matchKeyHint: The text of the bank rows this entry pays or receives. Leave empty to match its name. It also estimates a variable amount.
recurringBills.debtHint: Each confirmed payment is linked to the debt as a regular payment.
recurringBills.transferNoCategory: A transfer has no category: the money stays between your own accounts.
recurringBills.confirmAccountRequired: Choose the account this was paid from.
recurringBills.receivedAmountHint: The two accounts hold different currencies, so enter what arrived.
